pr_title: Add missing reset for ping clocks to avoid mistakenly sending GOAWAY frames due to 'too_many_pings'
pr_body:
Fixes #23146

Add missing reset for ping clocks to avoid mistakenly sending GOAWAY frames due to 'too_many_pings'

issue_context.title: Client receives GOAWAY frames when it receives lot of trailer-only responses

review_comments: I didn't check myself - are the server keepalive args unnecessary for this to reproduce?
yes, they were unnecessary. The default BDP ping is enough to trigger this.

As I understand the problem here was that the server thought that the client was violating GRPC_ARG_HTTP2_MIN_RECV_PING_INTERVAL_WITHOUT_DATA_MS ? If so I'm a little confused by the documentation around `GRPC_ARG_HTTP2_MIN_RECV_PING_INTERVAL_WITHOUT_DATA_MS`, that are described in https://github.com/grpc/grpc/blob/master/doc/keepalive.md. Mainly this wording: "If there are no data frames being sent on the transport", makes me think that the transport only cares data frames. Should the wording there be expanded beyond data frames to all frame types?
You are right. (Minor correction - "all frame types" - "data/header/window_update"). Created #23151
